title: Investigation into Aluminium Composite Claddings on Buildings with Potential Fire Risk
what_it_is: Investigation into Aluminium Composite Claddings on Buildings with Potential Fire Risk

sections.label: Composite panel test non-compliance
sections.summary: A building owner submitted Bolliya and Bolli-Core panels with Certificates of Conformity for testing, which found them non-compliant; SCDF identified six other buildings.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: A building owner proactively submitted samples of two models of composite panel that were used in its building project for tests.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: They submitted it for tests – Bolliya and Bolli-Core FR.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Those two models had been issued Certificates of Conformity (CoCs) by local certification bodies, which had certified them to be compliant with Fire Code requirements for use as cladding.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The tests, however, found the samples to be non-compliant.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: SCDF had made a further announcement on 8 December 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: It has identified six other buildings that could have used these two models of composite panel, and investigations on how this came about are still on-going.

sections.label: No evidence of subornment
sections.summary: At this stage there is no evidence or reason to suspect that any of them has been suborned.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: At this stage, we have no evidence, no reason to suspect that any of them has been suborned.

sections.label: Panel brands taken down
sections.summary: For Alubond, 17 have taken down and 18 are in the process of taking down; for Bolliya and Bolli-Core, three have taken down.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: For example, on Alubond, I think 17 have taken down, 18 are in the process of taking down.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: In respect of Bolliya and Bolli-Core, I think three have taken down.

sections.label: Problematic brands and expedited audits
sections.summary: These brands were identified as problematic, which is how Bolliya and Bolli-Core came up, and annual audits have been asked to be expedited.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: We have identified these brands as being problematic, and they better check, which is how it, for example, Bolliya and Bolli-Core came up.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: We have also asked for the annual audits to be expedited and this should cover all the others.
